families.name: csd
families.justification: Client-side window chrome lives above the strip band.

families.name: help
families.justification: Help is a host shell dialog, window-parented by design.

families.name: settings
families.justification: Settings is a host shell dialog, window-parented by design.

tab_modals.dismissal_proof: show_overlay/dismiss pair on TopLevelInWindowOverlay + hideEvent filter removal
hideEvent releases overlay state; dismissed signal shadowed for compat
QDialog close path; non-modal window flags
hideEvent + closeEvent + deleteLater all release the mouse-nav app filter

src/plugins/help/dialog.py.justification: Mouse back/forward navigation while Help is visible; child filter object released on hide/close/delete.

src/shared_toolkit/ui/decorate_dialog.py.justification: App-wide CSD auto-decoration interceptor (idempotent, single install).

src/ui/context_menu/line_edit_menu.py.justification: Global line-edit context-menu interceptor (idempotent, single install).

src/ui/actions/palette/dialog.py.justification: Command palette owns its app filter while open; removed on hide/close.

src/ui/main_window/startup.py.justification: Main-window EventHandler on app + window (host shell input routing).

src/ui/managers/ui_manager_parts/bootstr.justification: UI manager app filter for focus-change routing.

src/tabs/image_gallery/ui/events_firehos.justification: Dev-only raw input firehose (env-gated IMGSLI_EVENTS_FIREHOSE, single install, session-only trace aid).

src/tabs/image_gallery/ui/marquee_band.p.justification: Gallery marquee drag tracker: short-lived app filter installed on band start, removed on finish/cancel (balanced release pass-through preserves the hover-loss fix; same contract as the toolkit MarqueeBandGesture it replaces on the gallery path).

src/tabs/image_gallery/ui/quick_look/ove.justification: QuickLookOverlay raise+focus on show; window-parented (see tab_modals). Moved with show_for() into overlay_parts (plan-gallery-split-2026-10-17 Part C2).

src/tabs/image_gallery/ui/clean_review/_.justification: CleanReviewOverlay raise+focus on show; window-parented (see tab_modals).

src/shared_toolkit/ui/text_input_dialog..justification: Modal text-input dialog focuses its line edit on open (dialog family).

src/tabs/image_compare/plugins/video_edi.justification: Video editor dialog focuses timeline/self on show; dismissal asserted.

src/plugins/help/image_lightbox.py.justification: Help figure lightbox takes focus when opened so Esc/zoom/pan work; it is an in-window overlay parented to the Help dialog (dialog family), never a top-level window.
